text:
alice: Starting deploy window: rolling service-core 2.3.1 -> 2.4.0 canary (5%). Gates: SLO p95, error_rate, and 5xx. @ben on obs.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary=5% image=service-core:2.4.0 id=deploy-2401239876

ben: Observability smoke up: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/slo/service-core?orgId=1 :eyes: watching p95 / 5xx / queue-length

carol: Quick question — should we disable autoscaler during the first canary window? last time it injected noise.

dave: Agree, disable for first 10m. I'll flip the flag now.

deploy-bot: Autoscaler mode set -> manual for group core-canary by dave

oncall-bot: SLO smokecheck: baseline p95=120ms, error_rate=0.12% (5m window) ✅

alice: Canary shift to 5% complete.

ben: Seeing p95 creep to 210ms on canary hosts, error_rate ~0.8%  — looks correlated with kvcache miss spikes. snapshot of a host log:
```json
{"host":"core-canary-2","timestamp":"2026-03-20T03:14:00Z","5xx":12,"latency_p95_ms":210,"kvcache_miss":0.36}
```

carol: Noted. Correlating with Redis latency and client stack. pinging infra.

dave: If 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m we should start rollback checklist. tagging @alice.

ben: It's been ~4m. 5xx sustained at 0.7% and p95 >200ms. Raising rollback flag.

alice: :warning: Pausing rollout. Pinning traffic back to stable (service-core:2.3.1).

deploy-bot: Traffic pin executed: route core-service -> tag:2.3.1; canary aborted (deploy-2401239876)

oncall-bot: Post-pin SLO check: p95 trending -> 130ms, error_rate -> 0.15% (stabilizing) :white_check_mark:

ben: Filing follow-up: incident-lite IT-4721 (https://inc.redwood.com/IT-4721). Suspect kvcache eviction pattern interacting with new kernel + kv client. Adding logs and traces.

carol: For the release notes: include known issue — redis client vX can cause hot-keying on cold starts with kv cache configs.

dave: Plan: kernel patch + kv client bump, then re-run canary. Tentative window tomorrow 03:00 UTC, added to deploy calendar.

alice: Thanks team. Marking release blocked until fix. Moving discussion to postmortem thread. :thumbsup:
